Priya S: quick favor — can someone run a short latency+throughput smoke pass for spectral-9b (model catalog: spectral9b:v1) on runtime v2.14.1? target config: context=2048, batch=1, warmup=100, samples=200. want p50/p95 completion latency (for ~64-token outputs) and steady tokens/sec. post the exact command you ran and raw numbers. no quant for this pass. thanks :pray:

Evan: I can take this now. confirm runtime image is rwinf/runtime:2.14.1 and kv-cache enabled? also which instance type — g4dn or a100?

Priya S: yes runtime rwinf/runtime:2.14.1, kv-cache ON. use a100-40g if available, otherwise p4d. baseline is unquantized fp16.

Miguel: starting run on a100-40g now. command I used:

```bash
./perf_runner --model spectral9b:v1 \n  --runtime rwinf/runtime:2.14.1 \n  --device gpu0 \n  --context 2048 \n  --batch 1 \n  --warmup 100 \n  --samples 200 \n  --kv-cache on \n  --output-format simple
```

Miguel: raw summary (single-GPU, batch=1, 64-token generations):
```
p50 completion latency: 0.55s
p95 completion latency: 1.80s
avg token latency: 8.9 ms/token
steady tokens/sec: 320 tps
peak tokens/sec (batch=2): 580 tps
GPU memory used: 34.1 GB
GPU util (avg): 62%
observed tail jitter: ~120-150ms spikes correlated with GC/kv-cache compaction events
```

Miguel: notes — workload uses mixed attention (long context), we hit a KV cache compaction path when sequence length crosses the 1024 -> 2048 boundary which spikes p95. p50 is healthy.

Lena: nice numbers. can you dump the exact perf trace (flamegraph) and the run command with ENV used? would like to see kernel breakdown (attention vs matmul vs memcpy).

Miguel: attached short flame excerpt (paste below). ENV: RWINF_BATCHER=continuous, RWINF_TILING=on, CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=0. kernel breakdown top 3:
```
attention kernels: 48%
gemm fused kernels: 30%
memcpy/other: 12%
```

Priya S: useful — thanks. action items: (1) Miguel, rerun with forcing kv-cache static mode (no compaction) to confirm if p95 drops, (2) run a 4-bit quantized pass (q4_mixed) on same instance tomorrow and compare tokens/sec, (3) if p95 still high, we'll try tiling=off to see if tiling interaction is the cause.

Miguel: ack — I'll do the static-kvcache run now and queue q4_mixed overnight. will post numbers here.

ops-bot: scheduled perf job 6067891240 by Miguel started on a100-40g (job id: pj-7821) :gear:

Miguel: static-kvcache run results (same config):
```
p50 completion latency: 0.53s
p95 completion latency: 1.22s
avg token latency: 8.3 ms/token
steady tokens/sec: 340 tps
notes: p95 improved ~32% vs prior run, compaction appears to be primary cause of spikes
```

Lena: great, that narrows it down. for the q4_mixed run, please also include end-to-end inference quality check on 200 eval prompts and a quick cost delta estimate (tokens/sec -> tokens/hr -> $/hr).

Priya S: perfect. Miguel — once q4 numbers in, we'll decide whether to ship spectral9b:v1 as default (fp16) or recommend q4 for dedicated capacity. also add a short blurb for the model catalog page with p50/p95 and tokens/sec for both configs.

Miguel: will do. summary for now posted to the model-onboarding doc (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-catalog/spectral9b) :thumbsup:
